notes.title: CUTE RAGE: Chick and Piggy
notes.content:
Here’s another update to make your experience in Game Over Please even more fun (or frustrating, depends on your point of view)! Let’s get into the details because I know the pain and frustration are already hitting hard, but don’t worry, we’re here to give you that little push you need to keep suffering in style:

[h4]Brand New HUD![/h4]
The interface has been revamped! Now it’s cleaner and, of course, more annoying across multiple screens. Oh, and there’s a new mode selection screen so you can choose how you want to torture yourself!

[h4]New Skins, baby![/h4]
Two new skins for the ball are here! We’ve got the Chick (nope, you’re not escaping it) and the Pig (get ready to suffer with cuteness). Say goodbye to the basic ball!

[h4]Difficulty Adjustments![/h4]
We’ve made improvements to several levels to try to balance out this madness a little. Now the difficulty adjusts more fairly... or maybe not. It all depends on your mood, of course.

[h4]Tips for the poor souls![/h4]
If you're one of those who die more than expected, relax! Now there are tips in the levels to give you a hand... maybe even a "step-by-step" to help you not get lost so much.

[h4]New Achievements, who can handle it?[/h4]
We added 11 new achievements for you to kill yourself trying to unlock. It’s not going to be easy, but hey, that’s where the fun is, right?

[h4]Provocations, of course![/h4]
Yeah, I know you love being called a noob... so get ready, because new provocations are here to make your suffering even more... fun. It’s not just the game mocking you, I’m in on it too!

[h4]New Visual Effects[/h4]
Now, in addition to stressing out over the ball, you’ll also have new visual effects on the ball and NPCs to get you even more distracted. More ways to lose focus and screw up!

[h4]And what’s coming next?[/h4]
I know you’re all waiting for new levels and challenges, and I know some of you have already reached the end of the game (will we ever have peace?). Don’t worry, more cool stuff is on the way. But for now, the pain will continue, and it will be totally worth it... I promise. 😈

So, fasten your seat belts, and good luck... you’re gonna need it!

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146844/aac3cecd5eb39cf5863d73974e2080d6b925541a.jpg[/img][h3]Game Update - Game Over Please[/h3]

In this update, we focused on improvements to make your experience even smoother and more immersive. Check out the main highlights:

- Now, the stage number you’re playing is displayed directly in the pause menu. Just press "Esc" to access it and easily track your progress.
- Enhanced the PAUSE menu interface with a refined visual touch.

-Important Fixes- 
We implemented a fix for the bug reported by a player, where the ball couldn’t be moved at the start of the stage. With this update, all stage elements now position correctly before allowing ball movement, ensuring more stable gameplay.

Thank you for playing Game Over Please and for all the support and feedback that help us improve. Stay tuned, as we're working on new content and exciting updates coming soon!
